description: Reproducible v4 RUNG_TX fund+spend round-trip vectors. Each vector funds an MLSC output, spends it via signrungtx, and records both transactions plus a deterministic witness shape summary. Schnorr signature bytes vary across runs (fresh aux_rand) but witness structure is deterministic and is the artifact under test for cross-implementation byte-equivalence. Generated by test/functional/generate_rung_tx_spend_vectors.py — re-run to regenerate.

vectors.name: SIG single-rung Schnorr spend (round-trip)
vectors.notes: Witness contains one SIG block: PUBKEY (33 B) + SIGNATURE (64 B). SIGNATURE bytes vary per run (fresh Schnorr aux_rand); witness_shape is deterministic.

vectors.name: CLTV=0 immediate spend (Empty witness rule)
vectors.notes: CLTV witness is empty after E-022; tx-level nLockTime must satisfy the conditions NUMERIC.

vectors.name: ANCHOR marker spend (Empty witness rule)
vectors.notes: ANCHOR has no witness — pure marker block.

vectors.name: HASH_GUARDED preimage reveal (Reveal P)
vectors.notes: Witness = PREIMAGE only. Evaluator computes SHA256(preimage) and compares to conditions HASH256.

vectors.name: HASH_SIG spend (preimage + Schnorr sig)
vectors.notes: Compound rule (Reveal P + Fixed N). Witness = [PUBKEY, SIGNATURE, PREIMAGE].

vectors.name: MULTISIG 2-of-3 spend (Triplets K + Merkle proofs)
vectors.notes: Witness = K × (PUBKEY, MERKLE_PROOF, SIGNATURE) triplets. Inner pubkey-Merkle root in conditions binds the N-set; spender reveals K with proofs.

vectors.name: OUTPUT_CHECK spend (pin output[0] value band, no SPK)
vectors.notes: Witness empty. Spend tx vout[output_index] must have value ∈ [min_sats, max_sats]. script_hash = all-zeros means SPK check is skipped (a multi-vout MLSC tx shares one conditions_root and so all outputs share one SPK — pinning a specific SPK would be circular).

vectors.name: CSV=2 spend after delay elapsed
vectors.notes: CSV witness empty after E-022; nSequence ≥ conditions NUMERIC and the spent UTXO must be ≥ NUMERIC blocks old.

vectors.name: TIMELOCKED_SIG spend (CSV=2, sig + delay elapsed)
vectors.notes: Compound rule: SIG verifies pubkey + nSequence ≥ conditions NUMERIC. Witness = PUBKEY + SIGNATURE.

vectors.name: VAULT_LOCK hot-key spend (delay=0)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY(recovery), PUBKEY(hot), SIGNATURE]. Both pubkeys revealed so the rung leaf can be reconstructed (PubkeyCountForBlock=2). Either key may sign; this vector uses the hot key.

vectors.name: COSIGN cross-input SPK check (2-input spend)
vectors.notes: Spend tx has 2 inputs. The COSIGN evaluator at input[0] scans OTHER inputs and checks SHA256(spent_scriptPubKey) == conditions HASH256. input[1] is a P2TR script-path OP_TRUE wallet UTXO whose SPK matches the commit.

vectors.name: P2WPKH_LEGACY spend (HASH160-bound pubkey + sig)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY, SIGNATURE]. Evaluator checks HASH160(pubkey) == conditions HASH160 then verifies the Schnorr sig.

vectors.name: ADAPTOR_SIG spend (plain Schnorr pre-sig form)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY, SIGNATURE] (same shape as SIG). Plain Schnorr sig used here; the adaptor flow uses the same shape with an adapter-secret-tweaked sig.

vectors.name: PTLC spend (plain Schnorr, CSV=0)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY, SIGNATURE]. CSV NUMERIC arrives via conditions merge.

vectors.name: HTLC claim (receiver path: preimage + sig)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY(recv), PUBKEY(send), SIGNATURE, PREIMAGE, NUMERIC(path=0)]. Receiver path: SHA256 (preimage) == hash AND sig verifies pubkeys[0].

vectors.name: HTLC refund (sender path: empty preimage + CSV elapsed)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY(recv), PUBKEY(send), SIGNATURE, PREIMAGE(empty), NUMERIC(path=1)]. Refund path: sig verifies pubkeys[1] AND nSequence ≥ CSV.

vectors.name: ANCHOR_FEE 2-of-2 spend (compound anchor + fee band)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY, PUBKEY, SIGNATURE, SIGNATURE]. Both keys must sign for the 2-of-2 check.

vectors.name: MUSIG_THRESHOLD spend (aggregated key 1-of-1)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY, SIGNATURE]. The aggregated key is treated as a single Schnorr key for verification.

vectors.name: AMOUNT_LOCK spend (output[0] in band, change in vout[1])
vectors.notes: Witness empty. AMOUNT_LOCK enforces the spent output's value (`ctx.output_amount`) is within [min, max].

vectors.name: VAULT_LOCK hot-key spend (CSV=2 elapsed)
vectors.notes: Hot-key path — recovery sig fails first (the sig is by hot), then hot sig verifies AND CheckSequence (hot_delay) passes because nSequence=2 ≥ 2.

vectors.name: TIMELOCKED_MULTISIG 2-of-3 spend (CSV=2 elapsed)
vectors.notes: Witness = K × (PUBKEY, MERKLE_PROOF, SIGNATURE). CSV NUMERIC arrives via conditions merge; nSequence ≥ CSV.

vectors.name: P2PKH_LEGACY spend (HASH160-bound pubkey + sig)
vectors.notes: Same shape as P2WPKH_LEGACY — distinct evaluator (legacy P2PKH descriptor binding).

vectors.name: P2PK_LEGACY spend (bare pubkey + sig)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY, SIGNATURE]. Conditions commit only SCHEME; pubkey folds into Merkle leaf.

vectors.name: P2TR_LEGACY spend (BIP-341 key-path wrapper)
vectors.notes: Same wire shape as P2PK_LEGACY; distinct evaluator.

vectors.name: ANCHOR_ORACLE spend (oracle pubkey reveal)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY(oracle)]. Pure marker reveal of the oracle pubkey committed via Merkle leaf.

vectors.name: CLTV_SIG spend (sig + absolute nLockTime=0)
vectors.notes: Witness = [PUBKEY, SIGNATURE]. Compound: SIG check AND nLockTime ≥ conditions NUMERIC.
